title: LatentWorld
description: Synthetic-world spec for one judgment predicate: a latent severity axis with anchored descriptions, context fields for realistic rendering, and a population prior for band-mass weighting. Probes sweep the axis (psychophysics); realism enters only through the population prior, which is a placeholder until calibrated to real data.

text.description: The judgment predicate under measurement, quoted.

tree_node.description: Node id in a compiled tree this predicate corresponds to, if any.

anchors.description: Concrete condition descriptions pinned to axis positions. Renderers interpolate between bracketing anchors; vignettes must never state theta numerically.

context_fields.description: Realism knobs orthogonal to the axis (unit type, region). Varied so measured cutoffs are not artifacts of one vignette style.

population.description: Prior over theta for band-mass weighting. PLACEHOLDER until calibrated to real data (assessor/inspection records).
